product_one_liner.value: Pack provides an AI-powered people-development platform for HR teams at large organizations to map employee skills, assess gaps, and create personalized development paths.
product_one_liner.notes: Pack describes mapping current and missing workforce skills, identifying strategic capability needs, and creating AI-powered personalized learning paths for organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The company’s current public landing page offers email contact and links to terms and privacy, but no pricing link or pricing page; it directs prospects to ask for more information.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company’s testimonial page identifies Allianz Trade and Gruppo Amadori as organizations that partnered with Pack. | named_customers.0: The testimonial identifies Allianz Trade and its Talent Manager, who says it partnered with Pack. | named_customers.1: The testimonial identifies Gruppo Amadori and its People & Organization Director, who describes the Pack program.

employee_band.notes: Revelio Labs reports approximately 84 employees for Pack SRL as of June 2026, which falls in the 51-100 band. Other public estimates conflict, so this is medium confidence.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile identifies Barcelona as the headquarters city. | hq_country: The company profile identifies its headquarters as Barcelona, Spain.

founded_year.notes: The funding announcement describes Pack as founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index features HR-adviser articles and interviews about relationships, leadership and development, not at least two engineer-authored posts on product architecture, infrastructure, ML, data, incidents or open source.

public_docs.notes: The company site provides no public documentation/help link, and the dev subdomain rendering is only a sign-in screen rather than public documentation with several articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current open-positions board lists sales/BDR openings and a Full Stack Developer role; none of the listed job titles is an AI, ML or data-science role.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Pack’s safety page explicitly says it is GDPR compliant; GDPR is one of the requested listed items. | compliance_certs.0: The page explicitly states GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The investor announcement identifies the most recent round as a Series A. | funding_date: The investor announcement is dated December 2, 2025, so the month of the Series A is 2025-12. | funding_amount_usd: Acadian Ventures, a co-lead investor, states that it co-led Pack’s $6.7M Series A.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series A announcement is dated December 2025, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current open-positions board lists multiple Junior and Mid BDR vacancies, which qualify as business-development-representative hiring.

launched_6mo.notes: The company’s landing page says the new platform is launching on December 1, after the November 9 cutoff, while the latest visible blog items are February 2026 articles rather than product-launch announcements.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The BDR posting names use of Hubspot CRM in the role requirements. | crm_stack_signal.0: The BDR posting explicitly names Hubspot CRM.
